# Abdullah Sultan

> Abdullah Sultan is a student founder based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. He ships AI
> products at early-stage startups, builds developer tools, and runs a
> student-run startup incubator.
> He is an 11th-grade student at the American International School Riyadh (AIS-R).
> Not to be confused with other people named Abdullah Sultan. This is Abdullah
> Muhammad Sultan, also known as amsultan or amsultan2010.

Canonical site: https://www.amsultan.site/

## Built

- [fschoolai](https://fschoolai.com): Software and product intern at an edtech
  startup, summer 2026. Shipped a course-aware AI video tutor and a landing
  page/dashboard redesign; drove a marketing push past 1.3 million+ views
  across social, growing the waitlist past 1,500. Helped organize a YC Startup
  School afterparty showcasing the features he built, drawing 80+ attendees.
- [crosscode](https://getcrosscode.dev): Founder. Open-source MIT-licensed CLI
  that keeps a git checkout in sync between teammates and their coding agents.
  Published on npm as `crosscode-cli` with 1,700+ downloads. Works with
  Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any MCP client. Requires Node 24.
- [the downforce blog](https://www.downforceblog.com): Writer, since 2025.
  Formula 1 race reports and opinion pieces written from Riyadh. 28 posts
  across race reports, editorials, and guides; 400+ impressions within the
  first month.

## Lead

- [Z Combinator](https://www.zcombinator.dev): Founder and president. AIS-R's
  first student-run startup incubator. 15 members get the resources,
  mentorship, and opportunities they need to grow their own business within a
  semester, while still in high school. Hosts guest speaker sessions from U.C.
  Berkeley, University of Waterloo, Propeller, LlamaIndex, and 11x.
- Aspiring Doctors' Club (AIS-R, leader 2025-2026): Pioneered a
  tech-in-medicine curriculum using AI tools such as AlphaFold; ran a diabetes
  awareness session reaching 60+ students.
- Code Ninjas (Sienna, TX, volunteer, summer 2026): Coached 50+ elementary
  schoolers in robotics, game design, 3D modeling, and Python/Java. 100+
  volunteer hours.

## Record

- Awards (AIS-R, 2026): Inquisitive Learner Award, one of five students in the
  high school; Grade 10 Science Outstanding Achievement, one of three in the
  grade.
- Academics: Full IB Diploma Programme, class of 2028. Maths three grades
  ahead, in the highest course on offer. Four self-studied AP exams:
  Precalculus 5, Computer Science Principles 5, Computer Science A 4,
  Psychology 4.
- Certifications (2026): Claude Code in Action and AI Fluency: Framework and
  Foundations (Anthropic), Applied AI Workflow Foundations (OpenAI), Intro to
  Generative AI (AWS), Intro to Programming (Kaggle), Introduction to AI
  (Google).
